readme_conflict.why: README lines 90-91 state ankle plantarflexion positive (-1 under rule B). The push-off test (ankle angle), the calcn-frame lever arm and the late-stance test (ankle moment) all vote dorsiflexion positive (+1) in every leg, so the detector reports a conflict and applies nothing. Without the documentation the ankle moment applies +1 (two families) and the ankle angle is suggest +1 (push-off only). GT24-C02 reached the same conclusion independently.

hip_angle_suggest.why: Only hip stance extension (plate timing) is available; no marker reference, so one family.

knee_angle.why: Only the knee-range test (joint anatomy) is available; it cast too few votes on 2 incline legs (abstain).

hip_moment_suggest.why: Only stance timing; the hip lever arm and ID-light need hip, knee, heel and toe positions, which the Parsed data do not have.

knee_moment_abstain.why: The knee lever arm needs a knee position; no other knee-moment test exists.

powers.why: Power timing votes on level walking (hip) and level/incline walking (ankle); declines are outside it. The power identity needs the moment and angle applied, which no joint has here (the ankle moment applies only without documentation, and the ankle angle is suggest), so powers are suggest at most. Knee power has the identity only.
